name: google-cloud-cli
checks: Install from empty HOME with prefix containing literal $HOME, double spaces, backticks and $(printf INJECTED)
Default repeat install rejects existing directory and preserves bin/gcloud digest
Fresh shell clears OFFLINE_ROOT, OFFLINE_PREFIX, OFFLINE_AUDIT and recipe-only CLOUDSDK settings
Official ~/.bashrc supplies correct literal PATH and Bash completion
gcloud version, components list --only-local-state and valid config JSON work
Installed original install.sh executes directly with only native local snapshot URL override
Installed install.sh digest exactly matches original archive source
scope: Supplementary check uses the unchanged final build directory whose recipe, manifest and checksum list match the final archive validation. The primary report provides archive roundtrip coverage.
